description: Built-in managers only. Verified by dry-run extraction against this repo: Helm chart versions in the three HelmReleases, the podinfo image, GitHub Action SHA pins, and the Flux version in gotk-components.yaml are all detected.

NOT detected by any built-in manager, confirmed by the same dry-run: the kindest/node tag+digest in bootstrap/kind/cluster.yaml, and the gitleaks / kyverno-CLI / kubectl versions and checksums embedded in .github/workflows/repo-security.yml. Those are shell strings and a kind config, not package files. They need regex customManagers, which are deliberately deferred until this config has been observed running.

packageRules.description: Flux applies whatever lands on main, so an automerged update would deploy itself to the cluster without anyone reading it. Every update here is infrastructure and gets human review first.
